working_tree_note: The tested source file matches source_commit; this evidence packet and its index entries were added afterward.
case: PostgreSQL quoted enum CSV import under a transaction-local shadowed search_path

assertions: The target and shadow schemas have same-named quoted enum and import table objects with different enum labels.
CSV generated from the target table imports under a transaction-local search_path led by the shadow schema, and the plan casts to the escaped qualified target enum.
Imported rows retain the target PostgreSQL enum type, SQL NULL remains distinct from the literal NULL label, and sibling text matches the source.
The pre-existing target rows and same-named shadow rows remain unchanged; the shadow import table retains only its seed row.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --locked --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration value_contract_quoted_enum_identifiers_resist_shadowed_search_path -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1 --nocapture

validation.clippy: cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration -- -D warnings passed

remaining: Other enum identifier forms, search_path/session permutations, consumer combinations and the wider B3 matrix remain open.
